Workflow.Name: DealOS | Document intake
Workflow.Description: A document's file is uploaded (or it is set back to Pending) → Document Intelligence. Then: seller answered an ask (listing Needs Info) → Listing Verification; KYB document of a party → Onboarding KYB / Buyer Verification.
